newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Novartis sees margin improvement in 97.
newsitem.headline: Novartis sees margin improvement in 97.

text.p: Novartis AG expects good margin growth during the second half of the year and for its profit to benefit from a positive currency translation effect, chief financial officer Raymund Breu said.
"At the moment currencies are very favourable for us," Breu said in an interview with Reuters Financial Television.

He said the profit margin outlook was good in view of the fact that the group anticipated strong volume growth in its pharmaceutical, healthcare and nutrition businesses and it was now enjoying some of the synergy effects of the merger which formed the company.

Breu also said he was satisfied with the first half sales data reported by the company earlier, noting that management had warned the market that the group would not be able to maintain the high growth rate seen in the first quarter. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
